TRAFIKK Pipeline
================

.. raw:: html

   <div class="hero-section">
     <h1>TRAFIKK</h1>
     <p class="hero-tagline">
       Systematic prediction and mechanistic interpretation<br>
       of anticancer drug synergies
     </p>
   </div>

.. raw:: html

   <div class="module-grid">

     <div class="module-card">
       <span class="card-icon">🧬</span>
       <div class="card-title"><a href="celios/index.html">Celios</a></div>
       <p class="card-desc">Integrates cell-line omics data to calibrate the base network to specific biological contexts.</p>
       <span class="card-tag">Omics integration</span>
     </div>

     <div class="module-card">
       <span class="card-icon">🧩</span>
       <div class="card-title"><a href="gitsbe/index.html">Gitsbe</a></div>
       <p class="card-desc">Generates ensembles of logic-based models via genetic-algorithm parameterisation.</p>
       <span class="card-tag">Model ensembles</span>
     </div>

     <div class="module-card">
       <span class="card-icon">💊</span>
       <div class="card-title"><a href="drexpa/index.html">Drexpa</a></div>
       <p class="card-desc">Maps experimental drug panels to <em>in silico</em> perturbation profiles.</p>
       <span class="card-tag">Drug panels</span>
     </div>

     <div class="module-card">
       <span class="card-icon">⚡</span>
       <div class="card-title"><a href="oris/index.html">Oris</a></div>
       <p class="card-desc">Computes viability and synergy scores via signal-propagation analysis.</p>
       <span class="card-tag">Synergy scoring</span>
     </div>

     <div class="module-card">
       <span class="card-icon">📈</span>
       <div class="card-title"><a href="synco/index.html">Synco</a></div>
       <p class="card-desc">Benchmarks predictions against experimental synergy data with classification metrics.</p>
       <span class="card-tag">Benchmarking</span>
     </div>

     <div class="module-card">
       <span class="card-icon">🔎</span>
       <div class="card-title"><a href="siflex/index.html">Siflex</a></div>
       <p class="card-desc">Interactive pathway-level exploration of drug synergy effects on signalling networks.</p>
       <span class="card-tag">Visualisation</span>
     </div>

   </div>
